verdict.rationale: Otter documents a public API ("Otter API & Webhooks" on pricing page, "Custom Integrations with Otter's Public API") plus an MCP server with OAuth-based granular permissions, enabling AI-native access to meeting data. However, there is no detailed API reference/documentation link, no SDKs, rate limits, or endpoint schema shown, and no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of API usage. Missing for 10: actual API reference docs, endpoint/schema details, developer community validation of programmatic access.
